info.name: Apothecary
info.ability: Once per game, at night, choose another living player: they do not wake for their abilities that night, but their passive effects continue.

info.name: Accused
info.ability: If you were nominated during the day, that night you learn the registered team of the first player who nominated you. If affected, this information may be false.

presentation.title: First nominator's team
presentation.description: Show the Accused the registered team of the first player who nominated them.

info.name: Crossroads Peddler
info.ability: You begin with the Cursed Reliquary. Each night, its living holder keeps it or passes it to another living player; the Storyteller decides whether the new holder lives or dies. The curse ends when its holder dies.

presentation.title: You received the Cursed Reliquary
presentation.description: The curse remains with you while you live.

reliquaryFate.question: What fate does the Reliquary decree?

characters.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 128 128" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M25 93c22-12 23-46 50-58 8-4 19 2 15 12-7 17-34 18-39 39-3 12 14 17 24 8" fill="none" stroke="#ead8b6" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="m34 77-10-8m34-25-7-12m24 30 13-8" stroke="#b96b5b" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

info.name: The Thorn Seamstress
info.ability: Once per game, at night, choose two living players. At dawn, it becomes public which players were stitched. While both live, neither may nominate the other.

presentation.title: Jugadores cosidos
presentation.description: Estos dos jugadores han quedado cosidos por la Costurera de Espinos.

characters.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 128 128" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M50 30h28l8 20-8 42H50l-8-42z" fill="#e6a84c" stroke="#f6e5ba" stroke-width="6"/><path d="M64 17v13M45 99h38" stroke="#f6e5ba" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

info.name: The Forest Lamplighter
info.ability: Each day before the first nomination, publicly choose another player. Their first vote counts twice; yours does not count in that vote.

presentation.label: Ilumina un voto
presentation.title: El Farolero del Bosque
presentation.description: Elige públicamente a otro jugador antes de la primera nominación del día.

info.name: The Ash Raven
info.ability: Each night choose another player. At dawn learn whether any ability other than yours chose them that night.

characters.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 128 128" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><circle cx="64" cy="64" r="16" fill="#ead8b6"/><path d="M64 18v30M64 80v30M18 64h30M80 64h30M31 31l22 22M75 75l22 22M97 31 75 53M53 75 31 97" stroke="#ead8b6" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

info.name: The One-Eyed Miller
info.ability: Once per game after a vote you did not join is counted, publicly change its total by +1 or -1. It never drops below zero and the block is recalculated.

presentation.label: Inclina el recuento
presentation.title: El Molinero Tuerto
presentation.description: Después de una votación en la que no participaste, modifica públicamente el total en uno.

info.name: The Lady of the Cracked Mirror
info.ability: Once per game, choose another living player at night. Until dawn, the first foreign ability choosing exactly one of you redirects to the other if valid.

info.name: Clairaudient
info.ability: On the fourth night, if alive, you learn which other players resolved a night ability abnormally because they were affected by a marker.

presentation.title: Habilidades alteradas
presentation.description: Estos jugadores resolvieron al menos una habilidad nocturna de forma anómala porque una ficha afectaba sus habilidades.
